jobs.title: Director of Product Management - US Remote
jobs.jd_full:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Role Overview

PerfectServe is seeking a Director of Product Management – AI to own the product vision, strategy, and lifecycle of our AI-native answering service platform. This is a modern product leadership role: you will define what gets built and why, ground every decision in deep customer and clinical understanding, and move fast using the tools of contemporary product development — including AI-assisted prototyping, rapid experimentation, and data-driven iteration.

You are technically fluent enough to engage meaningfully with engineering architecture, evaluate AI capabilities critically, and prototype ideas yourself — but your primary orientation is toward the customer, the clinical workflow, and the business outcome. Reporting to the Sr Director, Product Management, you will be the connective tissue between healthcare operations teams, engineering, and executive leadership, translating complex clinical and interoperability needs into a clear, prioritized, and continuously evolving product roadmap.

Core Responsibilities

AI Product Vision & Roadmap Ownership

  • Define and own the product strategy for PerfectServe’s AI answering service, including near-term delivery commitments and a longer-horizon vision for how AI evolves across the portfolio.
  • Translate business objectives and clinical workflows into a prioritized, clearly reasoned product roadmap — and maintain it as a living document that reflects new information, not a static plan.
  • Partner with the CTO and Director of Software Engineering to align roadmap sequencing with technical capacity, architecture constraints, and infrastructure investments.
  • Make and communicate clear product tradeoff decisions: what is in scope, what is deferred, and why.

Customer & Clinical Discovery

  • Lead ongoing customer discovery efforts: conduct interviews, site visits (virtual or in-person), and workflow observation sessions with clinical and administrative end users.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of how healthcare organizations use answering services, operator consoles, and AI-augmented communication — including the pain points, workarounds, and compliance constraints that matter most.
  • Synthesize input from cross-functional teams, market and customers into product insights; distinguish signal from noise when stakeholder demands conflict.
  • Define user personas and jobs-to-be-done for the AI platform’s primary audiences: clinical staff, contact center agents, patients, and healthcare administrators.

AI-Native Product Development Practices

  • Use modern AI tools to accelerate your own product work: generate prototypes and wireframes, run rapid concept tests, and explore technical feasibility before committing engineering resources.
  • Design and run structured product experiments — A/B tests, pilot programs, shadow deployments — to validate hypotheses before broad rollout.
  • Define clear acceptance criteria and success metrics for every feature, including AI-specific measures such as containment rate, deflection accuracy, latency, and user-perceived quality.
  • Actively evaluate emerging AI capabilities (new LLMs, voice models, orchestration frameworks) and recommend adoption decisions based on product value and technical fit, not novelty.

Healthcare Interoperability & Workflow Expertise

  • Apply working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards — HL7, FHIR, and API integration patterns — to shape AI feature design and integration requirements.
  • Ensure AI features are designed with clinical workflow reality in mind: how nurses, physicians, schedulers, and operators interact with systems under time pressure.
  • Identify and manage product-level compliance and safety considerations including HIPAA, minimum necessary data principles, and the appropriate use of AI in clinical decision-adjacent contexts.
  • Collaborate with Clinical and Operations teams to ensure AI behavior aligns with care protocols, escalation paths, and patient safety standards.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Delivery

  • Own the relationship between product requirements and engineering delivery — writing precise, well-scoped specifications that reduce ambiguity without over-constraining implementation.
  • Serve as the product accountability owner for the outsourced development partner, reviewing deliverables against acceptance criteria and escalating quality issues promptly.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market sequencing for new AI features, including packaging, positioning, and customer communication.
  • Represent the product perspective in executive conversations; communicate roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and AI adoption risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Metrics, Learning & Continuous Improvement

  • Define the measurement framework for AI product performance: establish baselines, set targets, and drive quarterly reviews of key metrics with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Build a culture of learning from production data: use real-world call outcomes, error logs, and user feedback to continuously improve AI model performance and product design.
  • Identify and act on leading indicators of customer churn or dissatisfaction related to AI feature quality.

Team Leadership

  • Initially operate as an individual contributor; build out a product and design team as the platform and organization scale.
  • Establish PM practices and norms that support AI-native development: lightweight documentation, fast feedback loops, and outcome-oriented delivery measurement.
  • Mentor and develop junior product team members as the function grows.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years owning AI, NLP, or conversational AI products in production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead customer discovery in complex B2B environments; experience interviewing clinical or operational end users is a strong differentiator.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7 v2, FHIR, and API integration patterns. Able to engage in technical interoperability discussions without an engineer in the room.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and the product design considerations it requires: data minimization, audit trails, access controls, and PHI handling.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to evaluate AI capabilities critically, write clear functional specifications, and prototype concepts using no-code or AI-assisted tools.
  • Track record of shipping AI features at scale and iterating based on production data and user feedback.
  • Strong written communication; able to produce clear PRDs, executive summaries, and customer-facing feature descriptions.
  • Experience working with outsourced development partners, including delivery accountability and quality review.

Preferred

  • Experience with healthcare contact center operations, patient access workflows, or clinical communication platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with conversational AI platforms, voice agent frameworks, or telephony product design.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation practices, prompt engineering workflows, or AI product safety frameworks.
  • Experience in a growth-stage company where product practice is still being built, not just inherited.
  • Ability to prototype using tools such as Figma, Claude, Replit, or equivalent AI-assisted development environments.

Why This Role

You will own the product direction of one of PerfectServe’s highest-priority strategic platforms, with direct access to the CTO and the latitude to shape how AI is applied to real clinical and operational problems. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a large backlog from a distance — it is for a product leader who wants to be close to the work, close to the customer, and deeply invested in getting AI right in a domain where quality genuinely matters. As the platform and team grow, this role has a clear path to VP of Product.

Compensation

We offer a base salary range starting at $180,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.

The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Chief of Staff
jobs.jd_full:
About Waymark

Waymark is a team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders whose mission is to bring the best healthcare to people with Medicaid benefits. Guided by the communities we serve, we bring support and technology-enabled care to help primary care providers keep Medicaid patients healthy. We are building the tools and designing an approach to enable care to reach the patients who can benefit most.

Our core values embody the essence of what makes Waymark a unique team today, and what we look for, nurture, and sustain as a team.

  • We are bold builders, believing that the greatest challenges in care delivery can be solved when we harness the power of community and technology.
  • We are humble learners, seeking feedback and perspectives different from our own, and welcome challenges to our conclusions.
  • We experiment to improve, actively seeking data to inform decisions and to assess our own performance.
  • We act with focused urgency, our commitment to our mission drives us to tirelessly pursue results.

If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your creativity, your energy, your curiosity to Waymark.

About the Role

The Business Operations Director & Chief of Staff is a senior contributor responsible for how Waymark plans, communicates, and operates as a company. Reporting directly to the Head of Operations and working closely with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, this leader owns three interconnected mandates: the company's strategic planning and management system, company and internal communications, and the development of the business processes that keep a scaling organization coordinated and accountable.

This role blends the altitude of a strategy leader with the hands-on execution of an operator. You will run the top-level goal-setting processes through which the company sets direction — including company-level planning and performance reviews — and the communications through which that direction reaches every employee. You will design and continuously improve the operating infrastructure the company runs on, from decision-making frameworks to cross-functional workflows. And as a trusted thought partner and proxy for executive leadership, you will take on the ambiguous, high-stakes problems that don't fit neatly within any single function.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Planning & Management
    • Own the company's strategic planning system: refreshing the multi year strategic vision; translating company strategy into clear goals, priorities, and resource allocation decisions; designing and running company-level annual and quarterly planning cycles, rolling up department-level roadmaps and driving key prioritization decisions.
    • Drive the OKR / goal-setting process end to end — objective setting, results consolidation, progress monitoring, and corrective action — ensuring clarity, consistency, and accountability across all teams.
    • Run the executive operating rhythm: leadership team meeting cadence and agendas, decision tracking, quarterly business reviews, and executive offsites.
    • Provide executive leadership with insight and analysis on company performance, surfacing risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to inform key decisions.
    • Serve as a versatile utility player for the executive team: lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives and special projects, bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous problem spaces critical to Waymark's growth.
  • Company & Internal Communications
    • Own the company's internal communications strategy and calendar, ensuring employees understand company direction, priorities, progress, and key decisions.
    • Plan and produce all-company meetings, leadership communications, and company events — narrative, content, and logistics.
    • Draft and edit high-stakes executive communications: company-wide announcements, strategy narratives, decision memos, and executive presentations.
    • Co-lead the development of board narrative / decks for quarterly meetings.
    • Act as a conduit between the executive team and the broader organization — cascading decisions and strategic direction downward and channeling feedback, questions, and early signals of misalignment upward.
    • Ensure follow-through on decisions and commitments made in executive forums, routing actions to the right owners and driving them to closure.
  • Business Process Development
    • Design, implement, and continuously improve the core operating processes that keep the company coordinated as it scales — planning, reporting, decision-making, administration, and cross-functional coordination workflows.
    • Own the company's decision-making infrastructure, including decision-memo process, approval workflows, and vendor and procurement review, in partnership with Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and Security.
    • Identify organizational friction, process gaps, and duplicated effort; partner with functional leaders to redesign workflows and clarify ownership.
    • Sustain and improve the company's collaboration processes and tooling to maximize productivity and coordination across teams, including thoughtful adoption of AI tools.
    • Build lightweight systems for planning, reporting, and accountability that scale with the company without adding unnecessary process.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years in business operations, chief of staff, strategy, or consulting roles with direct healthcare experience; demonstrated success operating at the executive level in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; expert-level proficiency with PowerPoint deck creation and Excel modeling.
  • Strategic Planning: Hands-on experience designing and running company-level planning processes — annual/quarterly planning, OKRs or equivalent goal frameworks, and performance management rhythms.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive memos, decks, and company-wide communications; able to quickly distill complex concepts into clear, compelling narratives for executive and all-employee audiences.
  • Process & Systems Thinking: Track record of designing and implementing business processes, operating cadences, and decision frameworks that improve organizational execution.
  • Analytical Rigor: Financial and operational modeling skills, combining data-driven analysis with sound business intuition to pressure-test decisions on contracting, budgeting, and strategy.
  • Influence & Judgment: Ability to influence without authority, build trusted relationships across all levels, and handle confidential information with discretion; entrepreneurial self-starter who delivers results without waiting for direction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for improving care for Medicaid patients.
  • Healthcare experience in value-based care and/or tech-enabled care delivery.
  • Comfort with a range of collaboration tools (Slack, Jira, Confluence, Asana, HubSpot/Salesforce CRM, Jotform, Google Workspace) and proficiency with AI tools.
  • San Francisco–based preferred

Hiring Range

US Employees in San Francisco/Bay Area, New York City - $160,000 - $229,000

US Employees in Boston, Los Angeles, Seattle, Washington DC - $147,000 - $211,000

US Employees in Arlington, Denver, San Diego, Sacramento - $141,000 - $201,000

US Employees in Albany, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Central/Southern, Charlotte, Chicago, Dallas/Fort Worth, Detroit, Houston, Las Vegas, Miami, Milwaukee, Philadelphia, Portland, Research Triangle, Salt Lake City, Twin Cities - $128,000 - $183,000

US Employees in Baton Rouge, Birmingham, Charleston, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Daytona Beach, Indianapolis, Nashville, New Orleans, Omaha, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, St. Louis, Tampa - $124,000 - $177,000

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.

Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.

Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.

Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.

Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.

Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.

Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.

Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.

Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advance degree verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Panel & Recruitment (Remote, EU/UK)
jobs.jd_full:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

About the Role

Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research.

We’re looking for a Product Lead to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll set the product vision for how customers recruit and manage participants across Maze, working across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated, and future research experiences.

This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations, and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners, and other product teams.

You’ll own the customer and participant experiences as well as the systems behind them, helping Maze deliver a recruitment experience that is high-quality, reliable, and able to scale with increasingly complex customer needs.

You’ll work on:

  • Set the product vision and roadmap for recruitment and participant management across Maze.

  • Improve participant quality by building stronger feedback loops, quality signals, filtering, and experiences that reduce confusion for participants.

  • Make it easier for customers to recruit the audiences they need across different study types, including more complex enterprise use cases.

  • Understand panel performance and identify gaps in participant supply, quality, and fulfillment.

  • Partner with Panel Operations to continuously improve the tools, workflows, and handoffs used to fulfill recruitment requests.

  • Help evaluate and onboard new panel partners and determine where deeper integrations can improve quality, coverage, or efficiency.

  • Develop smarter ways to route studies to the right participant supply based on customer and study needs.

  • Stay close to the operational side of recruitment so product decisions are grounded in how participant fulfillment actually happens.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Research Partners on customer needs, recruitment feasibility, packaging, adoption, and opportunities where recruitment capabilities can unlock deals.

  • Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment, and the overall recruitment experience.

You should apply if:

  • You have experience as a Product Lead, or equivalent, owning complex product areas from strategy through execution.

  • You’re comfortable working on products that span software, operations, and external partners rather than living entirely within a single product surface.

  • You can turn messy, cross-functional problems into a clear product vision and an actionable roadmap.

  • You’re comfortable getting close to operational workflows and using what you learn to make better product decisions.

  • You have strong product judgment and are comfortable bringing a clear recommendation to the room, even when there isn’t a perfect answer.

  • You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design while bringing stakeholders from across the business into your product process.

  • You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  • You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities, and technical constraints.

  • You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and continuously learn from customers and internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with user research or research participant recruitment.

  • Experience building products with a meaningful operational component.

  • Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience.

  • Experience working with external partners, vendors, or integrations that are critical to the customer experience.

  • Experience building products for enterprise customers with complex requirements.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brandsinclude Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About the Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to join our Digital team. A Lead Product Manager operates across multiple product domains, influencing strategy beyond their immediate team. You’ll navigate ambiguity, align leaders and stakeholders around difficult decisions and elevate how product management is practiced across the organization.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and measurable outcomes across one or more product domains, ensuring roadmaps align with company strategy and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, and business insight to identify and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Lead complex product discovery efforts that span multiple teams, balancing customer value, business objectives, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities.
  • Make high-quality product decisions by synthesizing evidence, weighing tradeoffs, and creating clarity through ambiguity.
  • Partner with Engineering throughout delivery, supporting release planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement.
  • Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, stakeholders, and leadership through thoughtful communication and influence rather than authority.
  • Raise the quality of product management by developing and following reusable frameworks, operating practices, and setting standards that help teams make better product decisions.
  • Champion experimentation and continuous learning, ensuring product investments are measured, validated, and iterated based on customer and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI-native product management by identifying emerging capabilities, developing reusable AI workflows, and helping the organization thoughtfully integrate AI to improve research, decision-making, execution, and operational effectiveness while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years of product management experience delivering customer-facing digital products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or another related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated success defining product strategy and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes across complex initiatives or multiple product domains.
  • Exceptional product judgment with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and make high-quality strategic decisions.
  • Strong experience defining product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and roadmaps.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound product decisions, and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, senior stakeholders, and senior leadership throughout the product lifecycle.
  • High degree of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and bias toward action.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing large-scale customer-facing e-commerce or omnichannel digital products.
  • Experience with experimentation platforms and modern product analytics tools such as Heap, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Demonstrated curiosity for emerging AI technologies with hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to prototype ideas, automate workflows, and build lightweight solutions.
  • Experience integrating modern SaaS commerce technologies, including search, personalization, content management, payments, customer engagement, or related platforms.
Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, in a remote work location.

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:
  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday

Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $220,000. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Listening
jobs.jd_full:
Description

Sprout Social is seeking an experienced Product Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and scaling of our Listening product. This role is responsible for central elements of Sprout’s overall strategy: positioning Listening as a competitive advantage targeting the growing social intelligence market and driving a step change in adoption by Sprouts wider base

This is an individual contributor role requiring deep product leadership skills that can drive a transformation of our Listening product into a best in class provider of decision-grade social insights for our target personas

Why join Sprout’s Product team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to come in and drive a step change in the value and adoption of our Listening product.

Our Product team operates at the intersection of strategy, innovation, customer value, and go-to-market collaboration. We are focused on delivering unified, data-driven solutions across our multi-product portfolio. As part of the broader R&D organization, our team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to create impactful experiences for customers while driving measurable business outcomes. This cross-functional partnership ensures that our products not only meet technical excellence but are also positioned effectively in the market, aligning with customer needs and business growth objectives. You won’t just help set the vision for Listening, you’ll also play a key role in shaping our overall approach to our wider intelligence strategy, execution, and outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Continuously strengthen a deep understanding of the important jobs and decisions are customers face, how the market services those needs to today, strategic trends and the biggest opportunities for our product strategy and roadmap
  • Own Listening overall product strategy & roadmap getting org wide buy-in to the most impactful product bets for investment with clear, trackable pay-off metrics.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver on product bet investments, balancing near-term customer/revenue commitments against longer-term strategic goals. Drive innovative solutions that balance value with risk, effort and strategic alignment
  • Collaborate deeply with the pricing and packaging team to optimize pricing strategies for Listening balancing costs, sales, retention, expansion and multi-product attachment goals.
  • Act as connective tissue with Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience to ensure product direction and deliveries are centred in customer and market insights. Ensure GTM is delivered to maximise customers and prospects awareness and ability to try and adopt new releases
  • Establish and continuously improve the feedback signals that can drive future decisions - track customer pipeline, adoption and usage behaviours; competitive landscape, customer feedback, churn and closed lost drivers. Ensure regular direct customer engagement and provide support to internal customer escalations
  • Develop strong relationships and effective communications with stakeholders across R&D and wider Sprout. Advocate for Listening’s growth opportunities, influencing and ensuring alignment with wider business goals and priorities. Proactively communicate progress, risks, challenges and pivots.
  • You will be continuously challenging yourself and your peers to innovate - exploring new value creation opportunities - from unmet important customer needs to technology innovations and improvements in how we work as a product and wider team.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and visionary product leader to help our company accelerate the growth of our Listening product. If you can align teams around solving hard problems together to achieve business impact, we’d love to talk with you!

  • 10+ years of PM experience in a B2B product-driven SaaS or Analytics environment.
  • Proven success leading product growth in a multi-product portfolio company.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and GTM leaders to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Experience partnering with distributed engineering teams across different time zones
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and navigate complex technical concepts, constraints and trade-offs including communicating them to non-technical stakeholders
  • A bias toward customer and market insight: strong continuous discovery mindset to develop deep customer and user empathy about their needs and workflows, coupled with analytical and commercial acumen to identify usage, impact and pricing opportunities
  • Deep curiosity in rapidly changing landscapes affecting the social domain, software and the PM craft. The person must demonstrate a passion for continuous improvement (at a personal, team and product level) with an aptitude for hands-on learning and experimentation
  • Excellent organizational, time management, prioritization, and project management skills ensuring core leadership & roadmap priorities progress at a fast pace while also meeting other PM demands

**We are only looking for candidates in the EST or CST timezone due to heavy collaboration with international teams**

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Completing Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Partner with the VP of Product to set initial priorities and align on expectations for your role.
  • Start building relationships with product managers, engineers, and designers in your product team as well as across the broader Product Management team.
  • Immerse yourself in understanding our customers, their jobs to be done and testing how our product helps them.  Get hands-on with Sprout’s products, experiencing them from the customer’s perspective.
  • Establishing a working cadence with your engineering partners in US and Ireland, including how you’ll handle handoffs, async decisions, and the daily overlap window.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Partnering with senior product leaders to define key success metrics for your role and teams and how you will measure against them.
  • Participating in planning and roadmap processes and helping to shape the product roadmap for long-term success.
  • Lead day-to-day product execution for your team delivering value to customers. You’ll identify project goals, contribute to research and delivery, and organize releases.
  • Understand the engineering behind the Sprout product well enough that you can predict product trade-offs and ask your team productive questions.
  • Analyzing our qualitative and quantitative research to start forming hypotheses about how our product can better fit our customers’ lives.
  • Facilitating quarterly roadmap planning for your team and represent the plan to the rest of Sprout’s product teams, including executive leadership.
  • Collaborating with other product managers for cross-team problem solving and feature delivery. Develop a strong understanding of Sprout’s wider product portfolio and consider how customers’ workflow spans across them.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Becoming the expert in Sprout’s Listening product and confidently speaking to strategy, technical tradeoffs, and roadmap with internal and external stakeholders
  • Owning the Listening roadmap and delivering measurable results on key strategic initiatives.
  • Identify key opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration and alignment.
  • Standing up working cadences to build and deliver on product roadmap and outcomes in partnership with design, engineering, and GTM teams

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Making strategic recommendations across product, pricing, gtm and ways of working to drive outsized business impact
  • Consistently meeting and exceeding established performance targets.
  • Obtaining (solicited and unsolicited) and acting upon peer, customer, and leadership feedback.
  • Be ready to take on new challenges to help your team and the broader PM organization – including things we maybe haven’t even anticipated
  • Continue to evolve Sprout’s product culture, shaping the next generation of product managers.
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our ambition for Listening at Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet!

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Benefits: We cover 100% of the premiums for you and your eligible dependents, including comprehensive medical, dental (basic & major), vision, life insurance, and disability.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 25 days of vacation annually, plus 5 paid sick days, all public holidays, and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $950 CAD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Remote Work Support: A one-time $550 USD (equivalent) stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD (equivalent) stipend for internet.
  • Personalized Financial Wellness: No-cost, confidential access to financial experts through Your Money Line to support your personal financial goals.
  • Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child and eldercare options through Care.com.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

* This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: CA$145,200 – CA$181,500 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

The full base pay range for this role is CA$145,200 – CA$217,800.

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

Include the nature of your request and your preferred contact information. We’ll do everything we can to support your success during our recruitment process while upholding your privacy. Please note that only inquiries regarding accommodations will receive a response from this email address; other inquiries will not be addressed (e.g., you send your resume but are not requesting an accommodation).

Candidates for this remote work opportunity must be based in either Alberta, British Columbia or Ontario. If you are based in another location within Canada, we aren’t able to hire in your location at this time.

jobs.jd_full:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About the Role

Toast IQ Grow is an all-in-one growth and lifecycle solution designed to help restaurants attract more guests, keep them coming back, and increase revenue without adding extra work for operators. Delivering this value involves a complex mix of product, systems, operations and more.

The IQ Grow Flex team owns the top of the Toast IQ Grow funnel - everything from sale close to first campaign. We’re building the AI-powered context, onboarding and activation layer that compresses time-to-value, captures restaurant context and removes human bottlenecks from the path to go-live.

This is a growth PM role. You’ll start deep in onboarding, but the mandate is broader: find the leverage points across Guest products where product investment can drive direct business impact at scale.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Drive business growth, however you see fit: the mandate is outcome-oriented, but the tactics are up to the PM. Come in, identify and pursue the next high-impact bets.
  • Own restaurant context: Build tools that help Marketing Managers and AI Agents capture, synthesize, and act on restaurant context faster.
  • Drive onboarding efficiency: Reduce human dependency and compress time-to-live through product.
  • Drive activation and product value: Own the metrics that matter: time-to-first-campaign, feature adoption rates, and early retention signals. Identify what drives sustained usage, instrument the funnel, and partner with internal teams to experiment.

What you’ll work with

  • A fast-moving team with a flexible growth mindset
  • Cross-functional enthusiasm: support and collaboration from a variety of stakeholders
  • AI-native product development: agents, LLMs, structured knowledge stores
  • High visibility and impact: IQ Grow is the fastest growing product in the history of Toast

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally with experience in a growth environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity: this is a new team with a big mandate and room to shape direction
  • Strong cross-functional instincts: you’ll work across eng, design, ops, onboarding and multiple product teams
  • Interest in AI/agentic products: you don’t need to be an expert, but you should be curious
  • Bias to ship: we move fast and learn from live products

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we’re hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Position Summary:

The Product Analyst is a data-driven and detail-oriented professional responsible for supporting the analysis, maintenance, and enhancement of healthcare data products.

The role combines US healthcare claims data analysis, product validation, requirements documentation, dashboard development, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving abilities and hands-on experience using SQL, Power BI, and Excel to analyze complex datasets, investigate issues, assess business impact, and generate actionable insights.

The Product Analyst will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Engagement, and Account teams. This role will report to Product Owner.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Represents the Product team on all active projects.
  • Participates in the daily application operations / development stand-up meetings.
  • Supports data delivery for the clients subscribed to the product.
  • Work closely with team and stakeholders to develop and deliver high-quality data products.
  • Analyze large US healthcare claims datasets to identify patterns, data-quality issues, coverage gaps, and product-improvement opportunities.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, profiling, reconciliation, validation, and impact analysis.
  • Compare datasets and product outputs to assess the impact of source changes, revised business rules, data-period changes, and product enhancements.
  • Investigate complex data and product issues, perform root-cause analysis, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Analyze medical claims, pharmacy claims, prescription, payer, formulary, and patient-level data across patient, claim, payer, plan, and other relevant levels.
  • Support the validation of product outputs, analytical processes, data transformations, and machine-learning-generated results.
  • Create and maintain product documentation, including data dictionaries, business rules, requirements, test scenarios, and validation results.
  • Support functional testing, data validation, regression testing, defect investigation, and user acceptance testing.
  • Support feasibility assessments and proof-of-concept initiatives for new healthcare data and analytics capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (B.E.) or in Technology (B. Tech.). Degree in computer science or related fields preferred.

Minimum Required

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in healthcare analytics, product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, or a related role.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous business questions, investigate data discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing US healthcare data, with exposure to one or more of the following datasets, data sources, or equivalent healthcare datasets:
  • Medical, pharmacy claims, and patient-level data, such as McKesson Compile, Symphony PatientSource, Komodo Health or equivalent sources.
  • Formulary and market-access data, such as MMIT, DRG Fingertip, or equivalent sources.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Understanding of medical and pharmacy claims, payer hierarchies, BIN-PCN-Group data, formulary data, market access, or patient-services analytics.
  • Exposure to longitudinal patient analysis, treatment patterns, patient journeys, or payer-access analytics.
  • Familiarity with Python, APIs, JSON, or machine-learning output validation.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or Agile product-development practices.
  • Working knowledge of US Healthcare / Market Access would be an advantage.
  • Experience developing in HIPAA compliant ecosystem.

Other Required:

  • May require travel domestically and/or internationally including overnight stays up to 5%.

Competencies:

  • Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation: The successful candidate must have the ability to read, analyze, and interpret production data, financial reports, and legal documents. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal skills including ability to clearly respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, employees, and members of the business community. Must possess a rapid agility to reply to emails, provide instructions of work stream necessities or issues encountered, business and report writings in a succinct and informative manner.
  • Business Judgment and Strategic Thinking: Ability to think, act, and deliver value in the best interest of our clients with respect to common practices of the healthcare consulting field. Ability to extrapolate from the specific to the general and interpret from the general to the specific.
  • Analytic Skills: Framing macro problems into action steps or work plans for resolutions. Structuring a persuasive client presentation based on in-depth or expansive excel spreadsheets. Demonstrable interpretive and solution identification skills with the ability to understand multiple types of quantitative and qualitative data heightened with strong resolution skills.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and work effectively across the organization to accomplish team goals is critical. The successful candidate must possess excellent judgment, management, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to work with team members to convey results, incorporate enhancements and productionize processes across projects. Must be able to understand the dynamics of how a team interconnects and relies upon every member.
  • Strategic Thinking: Conceptualize outside of the aspects of a project at hand, with an ability to visualize how the work contributes to and drives forward the overall project.
  • Solutions oriented: must be able to display resourcefulness and confidence under pressure.
  • Resilience: must be able to look past obstacles and roadblocks, ask questions and for support, and find their way around any obstacle.

About the Company

Our client is a multi-generational, family-owned heavy civil contractor specializing in grading and wet utility construction throughout Southern California. The company self-performs the majority of its work and partners with general contractors on public, private, and federal projects.

With a lean, open-shop team and a strong, values-driven culture, the company emphasizes safety, technical excellence, and long-term relationships. Its leadership team is highly tenured, and regular company-wide safety and skills training reinforce its commitment to doing quality work and earning repeat business.

About the Position

Our client is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Wet Utilities to oversee multiple grading and wet utility projects from contract execution through final closeout. This individual will take ownership of project profitability, accuracy, and client relationships while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

The position will manage approximately $6–8 million in combined project backlog, with a target gross profit margin of 28% or higher.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Negotiate and administer contracts with clients, subcontractors, and vendors in coordination with the President.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, maintaining profitability, schedule performance, and budget targets.
  • Partner with Superintendents and Foremen to ensure work meets plans, specifications, safety requirements, and project KPIs.
  • Lead change management, including pricing and timely billing of change orders.
  • Oversee accurate project billing, WIP reporting, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Develop and monitor project budgets, prepare monthly Cost at Completion reports, and approve weekly job cost invoices.
  • Review daily field reports for cost code accuracy, budget performance, and schedule progress.
  • Conduct weekly job cost reviews with Superintendents and Foremen.
  • Participate in project turnover meetings and thoroughly understand contract terms, scope, plans, specifications, exclusions, and estimator agreements.
  • Coordinate procurement and ordering of long-lead materials and equipment.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, meeting minutes, QC/QA reports, as-builts, and closeout packages.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop Project Engineers.
  • Identify, understand, and manage project risks while protecting the interests of all parties involved.
  • Work within an established escalation structure, collaborating with the Director of Project Management and Director of Field Operations, with access to the President when needed.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager with a heavy civil subcontractor or specialty contractor. General contractor/prime contractor backgrounds alone will not be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of wet utilities, particularly water, sewer, and storm drain construction.
  • Grading, earthwork, and site development experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating contracts and taking ownership of project gross profit margins.
  • Strong financial management skills, including job costing, WIP reporting, billing, budgeting, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and overseeing combined backlogs.
  • Ability to mentor and develop Project Engineers.
  • Experience with projects involving military, K–12 and higher education, pharmaceutical/laboratory commercial, and high-density residential construction is beneficial.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to maintain firm positions while working collaboratively.
  • Ability to manage projects throughout Temecula and San Diego County.
  • Candidates based in Temecula Valley, Murrieta, or the Inland Empire are preferred.
  • Hybrid arrangements involving 2–3 office days per week may be considered for the right candidate.

Benefits

  • Base salary of $140,000–$160,000, depending on experience.
  • Annual profit-based bonus opportunity of up to approximately $10,000.
  • Medical insurance coverage for employees.
  • Two weeks of paid time off, with three weeks negotiable.
  • Six paid holidays.
  • Opportunity to join a family-owned organization with long-tenured leadership and a relationship-driven culture.
